items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 68:1
items.html: After the Partzufim raised MAN up to AB SAG of AK, the coupling of AB SAG took place, and the light of this coupling reached Atik of Atzilut. And it is known that the illumination of AB brings the bottom Hey down from the eyes to its place, and temporarily nullifies all the Parsaot, which are the new boundaries made in the second restriction, as is known. Therefore, the Parsa between Atzilut and Beria was also nullified, and the lower two thirds of NH of Atik that were in BYA — to which the discernment of the body and soul of ZON are attached — rose, and it raised them to Atzilut, in place of the two thirds of the middle NH standing in NHY of AA; and the middle two thirds rose to the place of the first two thirds of his NHY, standing in HGT of AA. (p. 914, Item 84)
